title: Cesar Azpilicueta joins Chelsea Legends squad taking on Tottenham | News | Official Site
text:
Cesar Azpilicueta joins Chelsea Legends squad taking on Tottenham | News | Official Site | Chelsea Football Club 
 On the day the current Chelsea team play Spurs, another of our Champions League-winning captains is confirmed for when Stamford Bridge hosts a clash between old rivals on Saturday 27 March. 
 The Chelsea Legends versus Tottenham Legends match will take place on Easter Weekend and raise crucial funds for Chelsea Foundation and its work bringing people together, creating healthier lives and shaping brighter futures in our local communities.
 Cesar Azpilicueta, the sixth-highest appearance-maker in our history who won every major trophy available to him while at Chelsea, joins another successful skipper, John Terry, plus Eden Hazard, Oscar and Chelsea Women's legendary captain Katie Chapman as the players announced so far.
They will be stirring great memories when they return to Stamford Bridge next spring with more legends to be announced in the coming weeks. Tickets for the match, which kicks off at 3pm on 27 March, are on general sale. 
 - Click to buy Chelsea Legends vs Tottenham Legends tickets 
 Ticket prices 
 Tickets for this match are priced as follows: 
 Adults: £35 
Juniors (under 20): £17.50 
Under 23: £17.50 
Seniors (66 or over): £17.50 
Personal assistant: free of charge 
 Tickets will be dispatched digitally to supporters – further details to follow. 
 All persons under the age of 16 will be required to attend the relevant area of the ground with, and sit in the ground next to, a person aged 18 years of age or over. 
 Club Chelsea Westview 
 Season ticket holders, True Blue+, True Blue and CFC Blue members can purchase tickets in Westview. 
 All Club Chelsea ticket purchases are subject to Club Chelsea terms and conditions. 
 Application process for supporters with access needs 
 Accessible season ticket holders and members can purchase tickets as outlined above via the application form available by clicking here or by phoning the access team on 0371 811 2012 or 0044 207 915 1950 (international callers).
 Accessible car parking 
 Supporters can click here to make an application for car parking from 10am on Wednesday 3 March. You will be required to display your Blue Badge while parked at Stamford Bridge. 
 Ticket exchange 
 There will be no ticket exchange in operation for this fixture. 
 Ticket forwarding 
 Supporters who have a Ticket Forwarding Membership can receive tickets from a season ticket holder or True Blue+, True Blue or CFC Blue member up until 12pm on Saturday 27 March. 
 Loyalty points 
 Supporters will receive zero loyalty points for this match. 
 Refunds 
 Please note refund requests must reach the ticket office no later than 3pm on Saturday 20 March. 
 The match will also provide support for Spurs in the Community.
